source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 17 May 1961, p. 5 ("County and rural council nominations")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: the returning officer's notice of result read in the Ulster Herald of 27 May 1961, p. 11.

note: Triennial election of Castlederg Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. There was no election in the district; all sixteen members were declared elected without a poll. E. C. H. Young, a co-opted member of the outgoing council, replaced R. K. Henderson. Returned unopposed.
